text.description_html:
ACORN-ST5BI, Smooth Black Iron Keyed Entry Door Knob Set

Door knobs with a solid black finish are not easy to find especially of this quality. It is easy to install and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. A keyed entry knob, this smooth black iron knob is for doors where a keyed lock might be needed.

A Keyed Entry is use when a keyed lock is needed on the outside. Push / turn button lock on inside.

Good for both exterior and interior use.

Also available matching:
Smooth Black Iron Passage Set
Smooth Black Iron Privacy Set

Features of Smooth Iron Door Knob Set:

  • Passage latch set for 1-3/4" or 1-3/8" thick doors
  • Backset: 2-3/8"
  • Fits pre-drilled doors.
  • Complete with rose and tubular latch.
  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
